mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is associated with negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days, as higher rates compress equity valuations and increase the cost of capital.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns in periods where FEDFUNDS increased by more than 0.25 percentage points over the past 3 months are not negative in more than 40% of instances (or Rank IC < 0.05 over 5 years).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly acceleration in consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL) exceeding 0.5 percentage points is associated with negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days, as investors anticipate central bank tightening in response to rising inflation.
failure_condition: In periods where CPIAUCSL monthly change exceeds 0.5%, the 20-day forward returns are not negative in more than 40% of instances (or Rank IC < 0.05 over 5 years).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous positive momentum in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) indicates a strengthening economy, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings growth is supported.
candidate_trigger: HOUST monthly change > 0.5% AND INDPRO monthly change > 0.5%
failure_condition: In periods where both HOUST and INDPRO show monthly growth exceeding 0.5%, the 20-day forward returns are not positive in more than 40% of instances (or Rank IC < 0.05 over 5 years).

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle economic expansions, a rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is associated with negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days, as the economy approaches a peak and monetary tightening becomes more impactful.
failure_condition: In periods identified as late-cycle expansion (e.g., UNRATE < 4.0% and GDP growth > 2.5% for two consecutive quarters), the 20-day forward returns following a 3-month increase in FEDFUNDS are not negative in more than 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate below 4.0% signals a tight labor market and strong economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where UNRATE is below 4.0%, the 20-day forward returns are not positive in more than 40% of instances (or Rank IC < 0.05 over 5 years).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in industrial production (INDPRO) exceeding 0.5 percentage points signals an economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings expectations are revised downward.
failure_condition: In periods where INDPRO monthly change falls below -0.5%, the 20-day forward returns are not negative in more than 40% of instances (or Rank IC < 0.05 over 5 years).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is associated with negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days, as market participants react immediately to monetary tightening signals.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns in periods where FEDFUNDS increased by more than 0.25 percentage points over the past 3 months are not negative in more than 40% of instances (or Rank IC < 0.05 over 5 years).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in housing starts (HOUST) exceeding 0.5 percentage points is associated with positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days, as it signals a robust housing market and broader economic expansion.
failure_condition: In periods where HOUST monthly change exceeds 0.5%, the 60-day forward returns are not positive in more than 40% of instances (or Rank IC < 0.05 over 5 years).
